From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up — need to relock a tight deep-dive window

Hi Lara,

Thanks again for carving out 30 minutes this morning — really valuable to hear about Acme's OT stack and the latency-sensitive inference paths you mentioned. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: primary goal is to evaluate Redwood for low-latency inference for tele-op and fleet coordination. Key constraints: 100ms P95, data residency in us-west, ability to pin model variants for canary rollouts.
- Next step: technical deep dive (30–45m) with Eng and Ops to run through architecture, pilot sizing, and a rough MAP.

I know calendars are tight — can you confirm one of these windows next week? If we don't get a firm yes by EOD Thursday we'll release both slots so we can reallocate to other pilots: 

1) Tue Jun 22, 10:00–10:45 PT (Jonas, Marissa, Redwood infra engineer)
2) Wed Jun 23, 14:00–14:45 PT (Jonas, Marissa, Redwood solutions)

I attached a short demo agenda and a draft mutual action plan to make the session concrete. If neither works, tell me two 30-minute windows and I will lock the best fit.

Thanks — talk soon.

Jonas Weber
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (agenda), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft MAP)

Jonas — apologies, our previous call ran late and I missed the last 10 minutes. Really appreciate the recap.

Both proposed slots look promising, but Ops just flagged a planned maintenance on Jun 22 08:00–11:00 PT that might spill over. Can we hold Wed Jun 23 at 14:00 as tentative? If Ops finishes early, I can confirm Tue, otherwise Wed.

If it helps, I'm available Thu Jun 24 09:30–10:00 PT or Fri Jun 25 11:00–11:30 PT as backup.

—Lara

Thanks for the quick update, Lara.

Let's do this to avoid another no-show and keep the calendar usable for both teams: I will provisionally hold Wed Jun 23 14:00–14:45 PT for the deep dive but we need a firm confirmation by EOD Tuesday Jun 22 18:00 PT. If we don't get that, I'll release the slot and offer the next open windows (Thu 09:30 or Fri 11:00) on a first-come basis.

Also: can you confirm the attendee list so we bring the right engineers? From our call I have: 
- Lara Kim (Platform Ops)
- 1x SRE (TBD)
- 1x Systems Eng (optional)

If Ops can only confirm after the maintenance, please reply with the name of the person who will confirm (so we can follow up directly).

I reattached the agenda + MAP; Marissa will be the session owner on our side.

Best,

Jonas
(on behalf of the Redwood Solutions team)
